# Ai Graphics LLC

> Custom apparel, uniform store, embroidery, and commercial printing company based in Homestead, Florida.

## About Ai Graphics
Ai Graphics is a premier custom apparel and commercial printing company located in Homestead, FL, serving Miami-Dade County (Homestead, Florida City, Cutler Bay, Kendall, and Greater Miami) and offering nationwide shipping across the US. We specialize in high-quality commercial embroidery, Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing, window graphics, microperforado, banners, signs, and marketing promotional items.

## Contact Information
- Website: https://aigraphicsfl.com/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1 (305) 970-5085
- Email: Sales@aigraphicsfl.com
- Service Areas: Homestead, FL; Florida City, FL; Cutler Bay, FL; Kendall, FL; Miami, FL; Nationwide USA shipping.

## Core Products & Services

### 1. Impresión DTF (Direct-to-Film Printing)
- Custom T-Shirts & Franelas: Full-color transfers on 100% cotton, polyester, and dry-fit fabrics.
- Workwear & Hi-Vis Polos: Industrial-grade shirts with durable company logo printing.
- Custom Hats & Caps: Heat-press transfer printing on all styles of headwear.
- School Uniforms & Senior Class: Custom graduation and school spirit wear.

### 2. Bordado Computarizado (Custom Embroidery)
- Custom Embroidered Caps: Flat embroidery and 3D Puff high-relief embroidery on all styles of hats (trucker, snapback, fitted, beanies, visors).
- Corporate & Work Polos: Professional stitching on polo shirts and workwear.
- School Uniforms: Embroidered crests, badges, skirts, and vests.
- Outerwear & Jackets: Heavy-duty jackets, hoodies, enguatadas, and custom patches.

### 3. Señalética & Gran Formato (Signs & Banners)
- Microperforado (One-Way Vision): Perforated vinyl for commercial storefronts and vehicle rear windows.
- Window Decals & Lettering: Storefront vinyl graphics, hours, and branding.
- Retractable Roll-Ups & Vinyl Banners: Portable trade show displays and heavy-duty outdoor banners with grommets.
- Rigid Signs: Coroplast yard signs and PVC boards with UV laminate protection.

### 4. Marketing Products & Promocionales
- Custom Die-Cut Stickers: Waterproof vinyl stickers for products, cars, and branding.
- Business Cards & Flyers: Premium cardstock business cards and marketing flyers.
- Displays: PVC and foam board / foam counter signs.
- Custom Drinkware: Sublimation mugs and custom glassware.

## Turnaround & Order Policies
- Turnaround Time: Standard production is 3-5 business days.
- Rush Orders: Priority rush service (24-48 hours) is available with expedited rates upon request.
- Minimum Orders: Flexible on apparel and uniforms (no strict minimums). Specific minimums apply to items like stickers and business cards (contact for details).
- Local Pickup: Available in Homestead / South Florida area.
- Shipping: Nationwide delivery available.
